newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes stronger against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes stronger against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed stronger at 43.7550/7700 to the dollar in interbank trading on Sunday against previous close at 43.7600/7800, dealers said.
They said a sharp rise in call money rates and the weekend closure of major international markets helped the local unit.
Activity in foreign currency deals was low and the market was focused on local currency trading, they said.

The interbank call money rates closed at 12 to 14 percent against previous close at seven to nine percent. Dealers said call rates shot up following payments against purchases of central bank bills worth about 2.85 billion taka. Bills were auctioned on Wednesday.
